user.title: CyberPower PDU
user.description: Select a PDU found on your network, or choose to enter an IP address manually.

manual.title: CyberPower PDU
manual.description: Enter the network address of your CyberPower PDU and the SNMP version to use.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PDU's network card.
data_description.snmp_version: v1 is the simplest. Use v3 if you have configured a USM user.

credentials.title: SNMP credentials
credentials.description: Credentials for {host}. For SNMP v1/v2c the defaults (public / private) match a factory PDU; the write community is required to control outlets.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the PDU over SNMP. Check the address, port, and credentials.
error.not_cyberpower: That device responded to SNMP but is not a CyberPower PDU.
error.cannot_identify: The PDU did not report a serial number or MAC address, so it cannot be identified reliably.
